method.allowanceBody: For each supported route, allowance = route p50 + max(5 minutes, 10% of route p50). The displayed share is the in-sample fraction at or below that threshold.
method.indexBody: Index = 100 × [0.65 × observed within-allowance share + 0.35 × exp(−scaled MAD ÷ summary p50)]. It is descriptive and does not establish future outcomes or causes.
method.limitsBody: The newest returned history is limited to {{limit}} rows. No traffic, weather, calendar target, promised arrival, driver identity, or driver intent is modeled; no holdout calibration has been performed.
method.matchingBody: Normalized addresses are preferred; otherwise coordinates are rounded to three decimals. Address changes or rounding can split or merge real places, and reverse travel is a different route.
method.normalizationBody: Each profile sample is 100 × drive duration ÷ that route p50, capped at 1,000, then averaged by sample. A value of 100 matches the route median; unequal support can leave residual route-mix effects.
method.notice: Use these results only as returned historical evidence; no arrival outcome is promised.
method.spreadBody: Scaled MAD = 1.4826 × median(|duration − route p50|). p10, p50, p90, and p90 minus p50 are observed historical evidence, not an arrival promise.
method.subtitle: Definitions, formulas, support gates, route grouping, and omitted inputs.
method.supportBody: Routes and route-windows need at least {{routeSamples}} and {{windowSamples}} samples. Route support = 100 × (0.45 × volume + 0.30 × active days + 0.25 × active weeks), separate from timing consistency.
method.timezoneBody: Hour, weekday, date, week, and month use {{timeZone}}. Multiple drives on one local day count as separate observations.
method.title: Methodology and limitations

quality.briefDescription: Loaded-drive accounting and recurrence are descriptive evidence. Support indices are not confidence scores or proof of continuous recording.
quality.briefScope: Loaded completed-drive population; source timestamps and denominators are shown separately.

quality.subtitle: Every returned row is counted once, while sample support remains separate from observed timing consistency.
quality.supportFormula: Global support index = 100 × (0.35 × supported-drive volume + 0.20 × supported-route count + 0.25 × supported active weeks + 0.20 × repeated-route coverage).
